qa_pair.question: In the metadata-only fixture, inspect discovery and permitted context. Can this connection prepare evidence without renewed product consent? Answer yes or no.
In the prepared divergent two-run fixture, read the supplied review and its result status. Has preparation itself authorized execution? Answer with the execution field.
In the prepared divergent two-run fixture, compare the pinned report and result status. Return the comparison state and result_available joined with a colon.
Inspect evidence-tool schemas and context in the enabled fixture. Which discovered operation lets the agent grant human approval? Answer none if no such tool exists.
Read the supplied review in the source-revoked fixture. Does the current result disclose comparison evidence? Return its state and whether evidence exists, joined with a colon.
Inspect current context and the supplied review in the source-expired fixture. Return the review state and whether evidence exists, joined with a colon.
In the source-changed fixture, read the supplied review and compare its status with the pending-review contract. Is its old evidence still current? Return the status.
After discovery in the revoked-grant fixture, attempt the supplied review read. Can a previously paid receipt bypass current grant checks? Answer yes or no.
In the pending-result fixture, inspect the review and result receipts. Does either contain an authoritative approved outcome? Answer yes or no.
Inspect tool discovery and permitted context in the evidence-disabled fixture. How many tools are available, and is preparation available? Join the number and boolean with a colon.
